title: Rear Main Seal Installation Tool Set for air-cooled 911
notes: Four STL files for centring and seating the rear main seal flush or 1 mm recessed. This is a workshop tool, not an installed vehicle part; dimensional and procedural validation remains mandatory. 2026-10-15: the original Thingiverse page (thing 2006970) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. The Internet Archive index lists a capture of that page dated 2017-04-24 (HTTP 200); it was not read, because the page-reading tool refuses web.archive.org. The CC-BY-SA (no version) statement rests only on the secondary archive, so redistribution is set to unknown, as for every Renn 3D Parts record, until the licence is read on the original page.
